sources.note: Main company website. Describes Medcare MSO as billing/RCM company since 2012, 80,000+ practitioners, 501-1000 employees. Lists products: Maximus PMS, AI Scribe, AI Medical Coding. Also offers billing services on top of third-party EHRs (NextGen, athenahealth, Cerner, etc.).

HealUs EHR product website. Sparse — lists six feature areas (scheduling, charting, eligibility verification, CDSS, interoperability, electronic referrals). Cloud-based, emphasizes quick setup. No detailed feature documentation on the main site.

ONC mandatory disclosures page. Lists all 37 certified criteria, 7 CQMs, additional software (DrFirst, EMR Direct, AccessGUDID). Notes some certified features may incur fees. Links to API documentation.
Company about page. Founded 2012, headquartered Irvine CA. Claims software used by 'nearly one million' physicians/NPs/healthcare professionals in 80,000+ facilities. 501-1000 employees.

Maximus PMS product page. Describes billing/claims management, automated claim scrubbing, AI-powered coding, scheduling, eligibility verification, patient portal, Power BI analytics, payment posting, denial management.

June 2024 press release announcing Maximus PMS. Highlights customizable dashboard, patient registration, claims management, payment posting, A/R tracking, analytics, HL7 integration, web-based platform.
Software Finder listing. Describes Medcare MSO as RCM platform using Maximus software. 5-star rating from single review. Custom pricing. Lists target audience: labs, practices, clinics, hospitals.
Digital.Health company profile. Basic info — founded 2012, Irvine CA, billing and administrative support services. Minimal additional detail.
Healthcare data integration services page. Supports HL7 v2, FHIR, DICOM, X12, CDA/XML, JSON. Integrates EHRs, LIS, RIS, pharmacy systems. No specific mention of HealUs EHR integration.
HealUs EHR Knowledge Hub / documentation portal. Page loaded mostly CSS with no visible content structure — appears to be a JavaScript-rendered app. Could not extract documentation content.
